note: Held-out eval briefs for the roblox-build lane (written 2026-10-29 before any pipeline output on them). Dev/tuning briefs are separate (dev list below) and never scored.

dev.brief: Abandoned gothic cathedral nave at dawn with rows of pews, columns, a collapsed corner and an altar.
A relaxing small-town cafe interior on a rainy afternoon: counter with coffee machines, cozy booths by the windows, plants, warm lamps, a reading corner.
Cozy two-room house: living room with sofa and fireplace, kitchen corner, garden with a fence outside.
Short obby course over water: jumping platforms, a spinner, kill bricks, checkpoints and a finish pad on an island.

heldout.brief: Small fishing-game map: a lake with a wooden dock, a bait shop, a few rowboats, trees around the shore and a lighthouse on a rocky point.
Museum dinosaur hall: a big skeleton as the centrepiece, display cases with fossils, rope barriers, info plaques, high windows.
Creepy abandoned theme park entrance at dusk: a gate arch with a sign, ticket booth, a broken carousel behind, flickering lamp posts, litter.
Abandoned aquarium hall: walk-through tunnel tank, dark wall tanks with algae, broken benches, a gift kiosk, water puddles.
Forest camp minigame arena: a clearing with tents, a campfire in the middle, log seats, cover walls for a round-based game, tall pines around.
Snowy winter cabin village at night: three small cabins with porches, snow pines, a frozen pond, lanterns and a snowman.
Abandoned subway station platform: a stopped train car, platform edge, tiled pillars, benches, a vending machine, turnstiles, flickering lights.
Cozy bookshop interior: tall bookcases, a reading table with green lamps, an armchair corner by a fireplace, a counter with a register.
Tropical beach minigame map: sand, palm trees, umbrellas and towels, a lifeguard tower, a dock into the sea, sandcastles.
Gothic library hall: two-storey bookcases, long reading tables, chandeliers, stained glass windows, a globe and a lectern at the end.
Japanese garden teahouse: a koi pond with an arched bridge, stone lanterns, a torii gate, bamboo, cherry trees and a small tea room with paper screens.
Derelict hospital ward at night: rows of beds with curtain dividers, IV stands, a nurse station counter, flickering lamps, papers on the floor.
